archetypes.name: dyn-wire-fixture-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Shared builders must not normalize negative fixtures or drift from seed_run_params serialization.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect design_wire.py and its call sites in the migrated design/rendering tests. Confirm malformed, fenced, injection, and fidelity fixtures stay inline. Confirm run_params_json matches session.run_params_text byte-for-byte, result_env_lines rejects newline/CR/NUL without production allowlist filtering, and plan_body heading/trailer grammar matches ordinary positive fixtures only. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
